statement: SDL outputs PS5 effects using 0x02 USB framing and 0x31 Bluetooth framing with an SDL-specific prefix and BT CRC. Rumble and LED effects require an enabled/enhanced mode; output request success does not attest physical haptics or audio routing.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 670-745, 1020-1068. SDL and Linux BT effect-prefix differences must not be conflated.
